1.title: U.S. Loss to Belgium Is Gut Punch, but Bright Future Remains for Soccer Here
1.summary: While the team failed to meet the hopes of many fans, this World Cup highlighted the game’s decades-long climb into the national consciousness. What comes next?

2.title: Did USA team fall short in World Cup? Here's what pundits think
2.summary: After weeks of excitement ended with a defeat to Belgium, there's gratitude and a sense of an opportunity missed.

3.title: Trump’s Tenuous Relationship With NATO Allies
3.summary: At this year’s NATO summit in Turkey, President Trump is arriving with his own priorities — and, as Tyler Pager, The Times’s White House correspondent, explains, they do not necessarily align with those of other NATO leaders.

4.title: Court Upholds Le Pen’s Conviction, but Leaves a Path to Presidency
4.summary: An appeals court confirmed Marine Le Pen’s embezzlement conviction, but shortened a ban on her eligibility for elected office. That could let the French far-right leader to run for president in 2027.

5.title: U.K. Live Updates: Farage Resigns and Says He Will Run Again in Special Election
5.summary: Nigel Farage, leader of the populist right-wing party Reform U.K., has come under increasing pressure after a series of revelations about undisclosed gifts and donations.

6.title: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
6.summary: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.
